admission.justification: A start-interleaved revoke must not erase the grant that a started leaf depends on.

applicability: The architect and developer grant-revoke writers when start evidence interleaves with removal.
conditions: The exact grant exists and the ordinary unstarted proof changes before the removal completes.
exclusions: Arbitrary external shell writes are outside product-interface authority.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_direct_execution_grants.py::test_revoke_restores_grant_when_start_interleaves_before_removal, test_revoke_after_start_is_refused; worker journal R4 section; R5 verdict 88c054160ffdffef415a01cdf0f09161bb59aa68944469379856e72944c46755

statement: A grant removal that meets a started leaf restores the exact removed record and refuses on both the architect and developer routes, so concurrent give/revoke outcomes stay serial-consistent.
